attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Eight names in one line, each with a couplet of its own, so eight folders; hers is «Eις την Xάρισσαν». The page gives no year: it sets them only «στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Δεκίου (249 - 251 μ.Χ.)», a reign and not a date, so there is no `dates` object. The corpus holds nobody of this name. The page prints no hymn in full.
